title: VisInteract: Towards Dynamic Interactive Text-to-Visualization under Imperfect Queries
abstract: arXiv:2609.15182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world visualization requests are routinely ambiguous, incomplete, or factually incorrect, yet existing Text-to-Visualization (Text-to-Vis) systems assume well-specified inputs and produce charts in a single pass. When queries are imperfect, a system must \emph{interact} with the user to recover the true intent, but no benchmark or method supports this dynamic process. We introduce \textbf{VisInteract}, a new paradigm that reframes Text-to-Vis as interaction-driven intent recovery, and \textbf{VisInteract-Bench}, to our knowledge, that is the first benchmark for dynamic interactive Text-to-Vis, featuring controlled imperfection injection, a leakage-controlled User Agent for realistic multi-turn feedback, and dual-perspective (code and chart) automated evaluation. translated_title: VisInteract：面向不完美查询的动态交互式文本到可视化生成
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的可视化请求通常存在模糊、不完整或事实性错误等问题，然而现有的文本到可视化系统假设输入是完全明确的，并在单次过程中直接生成图表。当查询不完美时，系统必须与用户交互以恢复真实意图，但目前没有任何基准或方法支持这一动态过程。我们提出了VisInteract，这是一种将文本到可视化重新定义为交互驱动意图恢复的新范式，同时提出了VisInteract-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个面向动态交互式文本到可视化的基准，其特点包括可控的不完美注入、用于实现真实多轮反馈的防泄漏用户代理，以及双视角（代码和图表）的自动化评估。在算法方面，我们提出了Vis-MCTS，一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的增强方法，对经典MCTS进行了改进，通过渐进式（原文截断）...
tldr: 提出VisInteract新范式，将文本到可视化任务重新定义为交互驱动的意图恢复过程，并推出首个动态交互式文本到可视化基准VisInteract-Bench及基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的Vis-MCTS方法，以应对不完美查询的挑战。
en_tdlr: VisInteract reframes Text-to-Visualization as interaction-driven intent recovery under imperfect queries, introducing the first dynamic interactive benchmark (VisInteract-Bench) with controlled imperfection injection and an enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search method (Vis-MCTS).
